newsitem.title: USA: National Media sees Q3 loss, Q4 profit.
newsitem.headline: National Media sees Q3 loss, Q4 profit.

text.p: National Media Corp said on Thursday that it expects to report a loss of up to $5.0 million, or $.16 per fully diluted share for its third fiscal quarter which will end December 31, 1996.
The company said it expects to return to profitability in its fourth fiscal quarter.
According to National Media, the loss expected for the third quarter is principally a result of a downturn in its U.S. business.
The company said its international business continued to be profitable during the same period, though its Japanese business was off.
The company also reported that Brian McAdams has decided to step down as chairman of the board and as an officer of the company at the end of the calendar year.
Ira Lubert, a managing director of TL Ventures, a venture capital fund, and currently a member of the National Media board of directors, will serve as interim chairman.
